# Deidre Mezbourian

Deidre Mezbourian is the current Connétable of [St Lawrence](https://flow.je/elections/st-lawrence) and was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2005.

Deidre Mezbourian has participated in 7 elections since 2002:

- [**2002 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/deidre-mezbourian#e3)

  Not elected.
- [**2005 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/deidre-mezbourian#e7)

  Elected as Deputy of St Lawrence with 48% of the ballot.
- [**2008 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/deidre-mezbourian#e11)

  Elected as Connétable of St Lawrence with 76.6% of the vote.

  - [2008 Full Manifesto](http://jerseyelections.info/constables/deidre-mezbourain.html)
- [**2011 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/deidre-mezbourian#e14)

  Elected as Connétable of St Lawrence with 53.7% of the vote.
- [**2014 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/deidre-mezbourian#e21)

  Elected as Connétable of St Lawrence unopposed.
- [**2018 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/deidre-mezbourian#e43)

  Elected as Connétable of St Lawrence unopposed.
- [**2022 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/deidre-mezbourian#e49)

  Elected as Connétable of St Lawrence with 52.6% of the vote.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/deidre-mezbourian/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e48NpISVsKo)

## Election History

### 2002 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy of [St Lawrence](https://flow.je/elections/st-lawrence) (2 seats), 27th November 2002.

**Deidre Mezbourian was not elected**.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Gerald Voisin](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/gerald-voisin)** |  | 877 | 70.9% |
| 2 | **[Maurice Dubras](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/maurice-dubras)** |  | 743 | 60.1% |
| 3 | Deidre Mezbourian |  | 550 | 44.5% |
| 4 | [Peter Whorrall](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/peter-whorrall) |  | 66 | 5.3% |

1,237 ballots

2,893 registered voters

= 42.8% turnout
